actionTitle.description: Title shown on the toolbar action icon

stateEnabled.description: State label shown while the feature is enabled (e.g. action title)

stateDisabled.description: State label shown while the feature is disabled (e.g. action title)

badgeOff.description: Short badge text overlaid on the action icon while disabled

optionsTitle.description: Title and heading of the options page

sectionScrubbing.description: Section heading for scroll behavior settings

optionOverlayEnabled.description: Label for the overlay on/off checkbox

optionOverlayEnabledHint.message: Shows frame number, timecode, and estimated FPS inside the player while scrubbing
optionOverlayEnabledHint.description: Help text for the overlay option

optionInvertDirection.description: Label for the direction inversion checkbox

optionInvertDirectionHint.message: When enabled, scrolling down steps forward and scrolling up steps back
optionInvertDirectionHint.description: Help text for the direction inversion option

optionCaptureModifier.description: Label for the capture modifier select

optionStepThreshold.description: Label for the wheel accumulation threshold input

optionStepThresholdHint.message: Each time the accumulated scroll delta exceeds this value, the video steps one frame. Lower values are more sensitive
optionStepThresholdHint.description: Help text for the wheel accumulation threshold

optionShiftStepSize.description: Label for the Shift multi-frame step size input

shiftConflictNotice.message: Shift is used as the capture condition, so Shift+scroll multi-frame stepping becomes unavailable
shiftConflictNotice.description: Notice shown when captureModifier is set to shift

optionManualFps.description: Label for the manual FPS input

optionManualFpsHint.message: 0 uses auto-detection and falls back to 30 fps when detection fails
optionManualFpsHint.description: Help text for the manual FPS option

statusSaved.description: Status message shown after settings are saved

statusInvalid.description: Status message shown when input validation fails

statusSaveFailed.description: Status message shown when writing to chrome.storage fails
